items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Let me see, it was Lips Page, Walter Page, Buster Smith, Dan Miner, -- who they never mention, he came from there into Benny Morton's band, trombone player.

ctx.x: Well, who else was in the Blue Devils when you joined them?
Let me see, it was Lips Page, Walter Page, Buster Smith, Dan Miner, -- who they never mention, he came from there into Benny Morton's band, trombone player.
